title: A card shipped to an agent runs it as a Claude screen
notes: #227 made pane run start a Claude screen by default but left the agent a move into Ship starts as Claude Code in a terminal (out of scope there). The user asked another project's main why its board ship opened a terminal worker; that is why. Change: the Ship agent runs as a Claude screen wherever pane run would (hasScreenHost), terminal on Windows, same rule and same decision entry (workers-decision-5). The review loop's agent too, if it starts one the same way. Tests for the choice; docs: ship/board README, workers-decision-5, history.
